source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 13ης Μαρτίου — «Άγιος Αβίβος από την Ερμούπολη»

attestations.note: The page holds one sentence and a bracket: he was from Hermoupolis of Egypt and took the crown of martyrdom after a great stone was bound to his body and he was thrown into the river, «(Ίσως είναι το ίδιο πρόσωπο με τον Άγιο Σαβίνο τον Αιγύπτιο, βλ. 16 Μαρτίου )» — perhaps he is the same person as the holy Sabinus the Egyptian, kept on 16 March. That perhaps is the page's own and nothing is joined on the strength of it; the two days are two entries of the Greek calendar. It gives no year and no hymn.
